title: AI Historian: Helping historians organize and verify person-centred temporal clues from dispersed historical narratives
abstract: arXiv:2608.29133v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: History is not preserved in complete, continuous form. Accounts of a person's activities, relationships and historical contexts are scattered across texts, chapters and narrative perspectives; historians must retrieve, identify and compare these materials to reconstruct temporal sequences and verify them against sources. Here we present AI Historian (AIH), an AI agent system that helps historians organize person-time evidence from dispersed biographical narratives. It takes source sentences as evidence units, identifies people and temporal cues, verifies candidate cross-text associations and infers comparable temporal ranges while preserving traceable source-text evidence. We evaluated AIH on six Shiji cases concerning Liu Bang, Xiang Yu and Xiao He. translated_title: AI历史学家：帮助历史学家整理和验证来自分散历史叙事中以人物为中心的时间线索
translated_abstract: 历史并非以完整、连续的形式保存下来。关于一个人的活动、关系和历史背景的记载散布于不同的文本、章节和叙事视角之中；历史学家必须检索、识别并比较这些材料，以重建时间序列并与原始史料进行核对。本文提出了AI历史学家（AIH），这是一个AI智能体系统，帮助历史学家从分散的传记叙事中整理人物-时间证据。该系统以源句子作为证据单元，识别人物和时间线索，验证候选的跨文本关联，并推断可比较的时间范围，同时保留可追溯的源文本证据。我们在《史记》中关于刘邦、项羽和萧何的六个案例上对AIH进行了评估。AIH智能体在时间定位任务上达到了86.2%的MicroIoU，相比之下，纯人工标注为81.3%，直接使用大语言模型提示仅为17.1%；其耗时约14分钟……
tldr: AI历史学家（AIH）是一个AI智能体系统，能够从分散的历史叙事中自动整理并验证以人物为中心的时间证据，在《史记》案例上的时间定位准确率（86.2%）超过了纯人工标注（81.3%）和直接大语言模型提示（17.1%），同时保留可追溯的源文本证据。
en_tdlr: AI Historian (AIH) is an AI agent system that organizes and verifies person-centred temporal evidence from dispersed historical narratives, achieving 86.2% temporal-localization accuracy on Shiji cases—outperforming both human-only annotation (81.3%) and direct LLM prompting (17.1%)—while preserving traceable source-text evidence.
